goal: Ship Japanese-readable Mission Control with task, organization, product completion, and test status views.
risk: A viewer-only implementation could look translated while still hiding current work, organization responsibility, or proof status from the operator.
loss_boundary: Do not claim operator visibility improved unless the screen exposes the requested status categories and the runtime audit chain resolves.
acceptance_gates: Japanese shell and labels are rendered by visibility-serve
task Kanban/list tabs exist and default Done task noise is trimmed
organization hierarchy and utilization are computed from canonical runtime artifacts
product completion and test/audit panels exist
release-state-audit passes after TASK-128 is marked done
notes: Work was opened after the UI request and backfilled with full governance artifacts when release-state-audit detected missing TASK-128 evidence.
